caption: The drawing is a technical, plan-view and sectional illustration of a desk, specifically labeled as "SCALE DRAWING of DESK owned by A. HAMILTON." The drawing is done in black ink on a beige or off-white background and includes precise measurements and labels. The main composition consists of a front elevation of the desk on the left and a side section view on the right. The desk has a tambour top (roll-top), multiple small internal compartments and drawers, brass knobs, and imitation drawer fronts attached to a movable writing surface. Decorative elements like satinwood and ebony inlays are indicated, with details specifying their thickness and placement. The labeling describes functional elements such as locks, hinges, and bead frames around drawers, and includes written notes for imitated drawer fronts and sliding mechanisms. The top is divided, showing both a "half lid opened" and "half lid closed" state above the main drawing. An internal plan at the top left illustrates smaller pigeonhole compartments and internal details. Various measurements in inches are included, specifying widths, depths, radii of curved edges, and thicknesses of materials. The bottom right corner credits the drafter as "BERNARD KRIEGER."
title: Secretary
